segments.name: Blanket
segments.description: Operates the Blanket gold mine in Zimbabwe, including satellite projects and solar power services, producing gold for sale.
segments.evidence: The Blanket operating segment comprises Caledonia Holdings Zimbabwe (Private) Limited, Blanket Mine (1983) (Private) Limited, Blanket's satellite projects and Caledonia Mining Services (Private) Limited ("CMS solar").

segments.name: South Africa
segments.description: Represents sales made by the South African subsidiary to the Blanket Mine.
segments.evidence: The South African segment represents the sales made by Caledonia Mining South Africa Proprietary Limited to the Blanket Mine.

segments.name: Bilboes oxide mine
segments.description: Comprises the oxide mining activities at the Bilboes gold mine in Zimbabwe.
segments.evidence: The Bilboes oxide mine segment comprises the oxide mining activities.

segments.name: E&E projects
segments.description: Holds exploration and evaluation activities for the Bilboes sulphide project and the Motapa and Maligreen projects.
segments.evidence: The E&E projects segment includes the exploration and evaluation activities of the Bilboes sulphide project as well as the Motapa and Maligreen projects.

revenueModel.text: The company earns revenue from selling gold produced at its mines, with the Blanket segment generating nearly all external revenue.

changes.text: In 2023 the company completed the acquisition of Bilboes Gold Limited, adding the Bilboes oxide mine and sulphide project.
changes.evidence: On January 6, 2023, Caledonia completed the acquisition of Bilboes Gold Limited (" Bilboes Gold ")
